name: Laundry POS System
summary: A multi-shop laundry POS for counter orders, numbered receipts, scannable bag tags, customer tracking, payments, and reporting.
problem: Handwritten slips get lost, clothes get mixed up, and it's hard to tell which orders are ready, which are late and who still has to pay.

features.title: Counter orders and pricing
features.description: Take laundry and dry-cleaning orders, charge by the piece or kilogram, and apply configurable urgent-service surcharges.

features.title: Receipts and scannable bag tags
features.description: Print per-shop numbered receipts and barcode bag tags. Scan a tag at the counter to find the matching order.

features.title: Order status and delivery
features.description: Mark orders ready or handed over, assign riders, and share a tracking link so customers can check their order status.

features.title: Payments and balances
features.description: Record cash, Bangla QR, and cash-on-delivery payments, track outstanding balances, and log refunds.

features.title: Shop reports and hotel statements
features.description: Review daily activity, export filtered orders as PDFs, and prepare monthly statements for hotel accounts.

features.title: Bangla and English workspace
features.description: Use the counter and order desk in Bangla or English. Each shop has its own catalog, settings, and receipt numbering.

audience: Multi-shop operators and laundries serving hotel accounts
description: Take orders for washing, ironing, and dry cleaning, print receipts and bag tags, and track each order from intake to handover. Staff can record payments, follow up on balances, and manage rider dispatch. The workspace supports Bangla and English, with shop-specific pricing, settings, and reporting.
